title: European AI rising star Nexos AI raises €30M to unlock enterprise AI adoption
description: Nord Security co-founders have closed a €30 million Series A for their new startup, Nexos.ai, an orchestration platform aimed at helping companies adopt AI securely.
author: Anna Heim

title: YC alum Cercli, an AI-powered Rippling for MENA, raises oversubscribed $12M Series A
description: In a region long defined by fragmented enterprise systems, outdated compliance tools, and HR software that rarely talks to finance, Cercli is building a unified alternative for MENA businesses with AI at its core. The Dubai-based startup, founded by ex-Careem operators Akeed Azmi and David Reche, has announced an oversubscribed $12 million Series A round led by […]
author: Tage Kene-Okafor

title: Top OpenAI, Google Brain researchers set off a $300M VC frenzy for their startup Periodic Labs
description: When Liam Fedus announced he was quitting OpenAI, VCs swarmed. One even wrote a love letter. Here's how Felicis' Peter Deng won the deal.
author: Julie Bort

title: Meta AI’s app downloads and daily users spiked after launch of ‘Vibes’ AI video feed
description: New data from Similarweb shows Meta AI’s mobile app is surging in popularity, jumping from 775,000 to 2.7 million daily active users in just four weeks. The app is now seeing roughly 300,000 new installs per day — up from under 200,000 previously.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Anthropic brings Claude Code to the web
description: Anthropic now lets developers spin up Claude Code agents, and manage them, from their web browser on desktop and mobile.
author: Maxwell Zeff

title: FTC removes Lina Khan-era posts about AI risks and open source
description: One post, authored by Khan’s staff, was published on January 3, 2025 with the title “AI and the Risk of Consumer Harm.” It  noted that the FTC was “taking note of AI’s potential for real-world instances of harm – from incentivizing commercial surveillance to enabling fraud and impersonation to perpetuating illegal discrimination.”
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: OpenEvidence, the ChatGPT for doctors, raises $200M at $6B valuation
description: Trained on medical journals like JAMA and the New England Journal of Medicine, the platform helps users quickly get answers to existing medical knowledge to help treat patients. Verified medical professionals can access OpenEvidence’s tool, which is supported by advertising, for free.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Last-minute ticket deal for TechCrunch Disrupt 2025: Save 60% on your plus-one
description: To celebrate the 7-day countdown, we’re offering a special 60% discount for your plus-one. Buy your pass and save up to $444, plus get 60% off a second ticket for your co-founder, partner, friend, or team member.

description: Seven days until TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 officially kicks off at San Francisco’s Moscone West and ticket prices increase. Save up to $444 now, and get 60% off a second ticket.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Adobe launches a foundry service that builds custom generative AI models for enterprises
description: Adobe will build custom AI models by training its Firefly model family on a brand's intellectual property.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Scale AI alum raises $9M for AI serving critical industries in MENA
description: Bilal Abu-Ghazaleh had just moved to London few days before our call, splitting his time between there and Dubai. After nearly a decade in the U.S., including a stint at Scale AI, he’s bringing that experience to his next venture: 1001 AI , a company creating AI infrastructure for critical industries across the Middle East […]
author: Tage Kene-Okafor

title: The man betting everything on AI and Bill Belichick
description: UNC Chancellor Lee Roberts is making big bets on AI and Bill Belichick, and he sounds like a Silicon Valley CEO while doing it.
author: Connie Loizos

title: OpenAI’s ‘embarrassing’ math
description: No, GPT-5 did not solve a bunch of previously unsolved math problems.
